about: Alamin Hossain is a freelance digital marketer and SEO specialist focused on growth, lead generation, paid ads, content strategy, and conversion-focused marketing systems.

services.name: SEO Strategy & Audit
services.description: Technical SEO, on-page optimization, keyword research, audits, and search visibility improvements.

services.name: Google Ads Campaigns
services.description: Search, display, remarketing, and conversion-focused paid campaigns for businesses.

services.name: Meta Ads & Funnel Setup
services.description: Facebook and Instagram ads, audience targeting, and lead capture funnels.

services.name: Social Media Marketing
services.description: Content planning, social presence management, and audience growth.

services.name: Website Optimization
services.description: Landing page improvements, conversion-focused design guidance, and analytics tracking.

services.name: Lead Generation Systems
services.description: Systems that help attract qualified leads and improve the sales pipeline.

pricing.summary: Pricing depends on project scope, channel mix, and campaign complexity. Typical engagement options include audit-only, monthly management, and growth-system setup.

portfolioHighlights.result: Improved search visibility and higher qualified traffic for client websites.
Created conversion-oriented funnels that improved lead quality and campaign efficiency.
Strengthened social media presence and customer engagement across digital channels.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, website optimization, and growth-focused lead generation systems.

faqs.question: How much do your services cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the project. I usually provide custom packages based on scope, timeline, and expected results.

faqs.question: Can you help with a new website or landing page?
faqs.answer: Yes, I can help improve visibility, messaging, conversion flow, and campaign setup for new or existing websites.

faqs.question: Do you work with small businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes, I work with small businesses, startups, and growing brands that need better online visibility and measurable lead generation.

chatbotGuidelines.responseStyle: answer clearly, ask one helpful follow-up question when useful, and escalate only when the request is urgent, legally sensitive, or highly specific.
